question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Touched**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Touched **means having been emotionally moved or affected. (**व्याकुल**)

 
 
• **Example**: The heartfelt speech by the teacher touched the students, bringing tears to their eyes.
 
 
 
• The word "**touched**" is appropriate because it suggests physical contact or connection.
 
• In this scenario, the man physically reached out and made contact with the little girl by touching her shoulder.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Felt: **Perceived or experienced emotionally. (**अनुभव**)
 
• **Contacted: **Reached out or communicated with someone. (**संपर्क स्थापित करना**)
 
• **Cracked: **Broken or damaged, often with a visible split or fracture. (**फटा**)
